nodes.name: HarrisReplay.harris
nodes.proof_sketch: Reduce the Harris inequality to iterated nonnegativity and inner integral expansion.

nodes.name: HarrisReplay.iterated_nonneg
nodes.statement:
theorem iterated_nonneg {Y : Type*} [LinearOrder Y] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {φ ψ : Y → ℝ} (hφ : Monotone φ) (hψ : Monotone ψ) (ν : Measure Y) :
    0 ≤ ∫ y, (∫ x, (φ x - φ y) * (ψ x - ψ y) ∂ν) ∂ν
nodes.proof_sketch: Use monotonicity and the sign of the two differences pointwise.

nodes.name: HarrisReplay.inner_expansion
nodes.statement:
theorem inner_expansion {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {φ ψ : Y → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable φ ν) (hg : Integrable ψ ν)
    (hfg : Integrable (fun x => φ x * ψ x) ν) (y : Y) :
    (∫ x, (φ x - φ y) * (ψ x - ψ y) ∂ν) =
      (∫ x, φ x * ψ x ∂ν) - φ y * (∫ x, ψ x ∂ν) -
        ψ y * (∫ x, φ x ∂ν) + φ y * ψ y
nodes.proof_sketch: Expand the integrand and use probability-measure integral identities.
